subject.title: fix(discord): preserve gateway messages across dispatch crashes

question: Should the Discord owner keep the durable-ingress design and repair the debounce-lane and deferred-error disposition paths before merge?
rationale: The intended reliability improvement aligns with the linked channel-ingress program, but choosing the correct lane/adoption coordination requires confirmation against Discord’s established batching semantics and the shared drain contract.

options.title: Repair the adapter before merge
options.body: Keep the durable drain, but add a lane/adoption design that preserves configured debounce batching and forwards deferred failure errors to ingress classification.

options.title: Pause for an owner design check
options.body: Hold the PR until the Discord and shared-ingress owners confirm the intended lane and deferred-settlement contract.

recommendation.title: Repair the adapter before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the durable drain, but add a lane/adoption design that preserves configured debounce batching and forwards deferred failure errors to ingress classification.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current ingress adapter and its shutdown-race follow-up.
